name: bricklabs [UPDATE]
desc:
Private servers are free, and you don't need RainbowBrick to play in a private server with friends!
LIKE AND FAVORITE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES! 

Please scroll down for our community server in social links!

There are over 167 unique bricks.
Search up "how to build a car in bricklabs" if you want a video teaching you how to build a car!

Chemistry game. Discover all kinds of bricks that do many different things, and experiment on them as you go!

This game has a lot of things to do, ranging from:
 - chemistry
 - mining
 - lt2 building
 - complex wiring
 - tree genetics
and more!!


You can only get the money badges in SINGLEPLAYER!
